# Laser rangefinder module database

> Open, manufacturer-sourced dataset of 165 single-point laser rangefinder / LiDAR distance modules (plus 2 single-beam scanning rangefinders and 12 pulsed laser sources; data date 2026-11-17): wavelength, range with target condition, accuracy, rate, interface, weight, public price, open-source drivers, source URL and capture date for each row. MIT licence. Maintained by ERDI TECH LTD (erdilrf.com), which also makes some listed modules; rows for every maker follow the same rules.

Manufacturers: ERDI LASER (ERDI TECH LTD), JRT, Benewake, LightWare, DFRobot, Lumispot Tech, Nooploop, Noptel, Jenoptik, Safran Vectronix, Terabee, Garmin.

## Data

- [modules.csv](https://erditech.com/laser-rangefinder-module-database/data/modules.csv): all rows, one module per line
- [modules.json](https://erditech.com/laser-rangefinder-module-database/data/modules.json): same data as JSON
- [schema.json](https://erditech.com/laser-rangefinder-module-database/data/schema.json): field definitions and units
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/ErdiTech/laser-rangefinder-module-database): source, history, validation tests

- [Laser rangefinder modules with a published I2C interface](https://erditech.com/laser-rangefinder-module-database/guides/i2c-rangefinder-modules/): 37 modules matching: category is rangefinder module, published interface includes I2C, IIC or I²C, published max range is present, and status is not discontinued; unknown status remains unknown. Manufacturer-sourced specs, prices and source links.
- [Laser rangefinder modules for a 1 km drone altimeter](https://erditech.com/laser-rangefinder-module-database/guides/drone-altimeter-1km/): 49 modules matching: published max range ≥ 1,000 m, published weight ≤ 60 g, and a UART, I2C or CAN interface that a flight controller or companion computer can read. Manufacturer-sourced specs, prices and source links.
- [Eye-safe 1535 / 1550 nm laser rangefinder modules](https://erditech.com/laser-rangefinder-module-database/guides/eye-safe-1535nm/): 63 modules matching: published wavelength 1400-1700 nm (in practice 1535 and 1550 nm Er:glass or fibre-laser based modules). Manufacturer-sourced specs, prices and source links.
- [Long-range laser rangefinder modules (over 2 km)](https://erditech.com/laser-rangefinder-module-database/guides/long-range-over-2km/): 70 modules matching: published max range ≥ 2,000 m (any wavelength). Manufacturer-sourced specs, prices and source links.
- [Low-cost laser rangefinder modules: public price under $50](https://erditech.com/laser-rangefinder-module-database/guides/under-50-usd/): 11 modules matching: a public single-unit price of $50 or less on the manufacturer's own site. Manufacturer-sourced specs, prices and source links.
- [Laser rangefinder modules with open-source ROS 2, Arduino or ArduPilot drivers](https://erditech.com/laser-rangefinder-module-database/guides/open-source-driver-ros2-arduino/): 58 modules matching: at least one open-source driver or documented open-source flight-stack integration that names the exact model (manufacturer repositories, ArduPilot AP_RangeFinder documentation). Manufacturer-sourced specs, prices and source links.
- [Laser rangefinder module selection guides](https://erditech.com/laser-rangefinder-module-database/guides/): Selection guides built from an open dataset: drone altimeter 1 km, eye-safe 1535 nm, over 2 km, under $50, open-source drivers.
- [905 nm vs 1535 nm laser rangefinder modules: range, weight, price and vendors](https://erditech.com/laser-rangefinder-module-database/compare/905nm-vs-1535nm/): Data-based comparison of 905 nm and 1535 nm laser rangefinder modules: range, weight, public price, interfaces and which manufacturers sell each wavelength.
- [TFmini vs SF11 vs long-range laser rangefinder modules for drones](https://erditech.com/laser-rangefinder-module-database/compare/tfmini-vs-sf11-vs-long-range/): Three classes of drone rangefinders compared from an open dataset: short-range ToF (TFmini class), 100-600 m LiDAR (SF11 class) and 1 km+ laser rangefinder modules, with weight, rate, interface and price.
